scope: Research-data invariants and simulated private-media import; does not prove hosted Storage or factual truth

results.name: six canonical IDs/slugs, existing categories and draft-only research package
descriptions and sourced coordinate fields validate without demo prices or invented review flags
selected originals and derivatives have exact byte fingerprints and rights metadata
genuine-session guard refuses wrong project and denied admin before writes
preflight rejects altered canonical draft and untrusted file path before mutation
private media import associates sources and cover choices but never approves/publishes/deletes
rerun skips already-associated canonical sources without duplicate uploads
checksum mismatch fails before upload; partial metadata failure is preserved and blocks blind retry
public adapters accept completed field shapes and category filters without publishing live drafts
